gaps.sentence: These apples cost two euros ___ kilo.
gaps.explanation: 'A/per' is used for rates: two euros a kilo, twice a week, 60 km an hour.

gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: We're going to ___ Algarve for a fortnight in June.
gaps.explanation: Region names often take the: the Algarve, the Riviera.

gaps.sentence: The novel had a huge effect on ___ young people of the 1960s.
gaps.explanation: 'The young people of the 1960s' — defined by the of-phrase, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best film of the decade by common consent.
It was ___ honour to meet the ambassador.
gaps.explanation: 'Honour' starts with a vowel sound (silent h), so 'an honour'.

gaps.sentence: ___ poverty remains a serious issue worldwide.
___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.
